subject.title: [Feature]: Expose sessionKey/runId to outbound message hook for deterministic verification

question: What bounded outbound verification evidence, if any, may plugin hooks receive before delivery?
rationale: The missing behavior is a public plugin API decision that can expose sensitive transcript/tool-result data and must define redaction, size, trust, and path coverage before implementation.

options.title: Design bounded hook evidence
options.body: Specify minimal redacted run/session/evidence fields for the supported pre-send hook, then implement the contract with tests and docs.

options.title: Use reply_payload_sending
options.body: Declare reply_payload_sending plus existing run context as the supported verification path and narrow this issue to any remaining evidence gaps.

options.title: Fold into trace policy
options.body: Make the broader trace/outbound policy work canonical after preserving this issue's deterministic verification examples.

recommendation.title: Design bounded hook evidence
recommendation.body: Specify minimal redacted run/session/evidence fields for the supported pre-send hook, then implement the contract with tests and docs.

likelyOwner.reason: They already reviewed this exact contract gap and show current-source ownership signals on the hook/outbound paths.
